full_judgment: 9. When the tenant raises the question of Sufficiency of notice and asks for a notice of a longer duration on the ground of the tenancy being for manufacturing  poses within the meaning of Section 106 of the Transfer of Property Act, the burden of proof lies on the party who claims it to be so. The extent of the burden is to establish that either the exclusive purpose or the dominant purpose of the lease was the manufacturing purpose.
